prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet adoption: Defer account sign-in until after users choose and customize their desktop pet. (why: Sign-in loses 27.1% of users right away; letting users pick their pet first builds emotional connection before requiring account setup.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop controls quick guide: Insert a new onboarding step showing how to click, move, hide, and interact with the pet on desktop. (why: Support receives frequent post-onboarding confusion tickets from users unsure how to control or hide their new desktop pet.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive waiting room with ready alert: Transform waiting time into an interactive mini-pet preview arena with progress timer and background completion alerts. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and 18.7% drop-off while pet generation renders.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing account account recovery hint: Display an informative prompt on sign-in clarifying how returning users can recover previously adopted pets. (why: Support logged 8 emails from users who lost or reset pets after inadvertently creating a new account during sign-in.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Grid layout for creation path selection: Switch path selection to a structured grid layout clearly separating ready-to-adopt pets from photo creation. (why: Users take an average of 514s on choose_path, suggesting confusion between standard adoption and custom creation paths.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Action-oriented intro call-to-action: Update story screen headline and button text to emphasize quick 2-minute adoption. (why: 23.8% of users drop off on the initial choose_path / story transition.)
6: [home, notification] Background generation desktop alert: Prompt users on waiting screen that they can safely minimize the app and get notified when ready. (why: The home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s as users tab away to other applications.)

scores.note: High sign_in drop-off (27.1%); deferring auth is a proven friction reducer but requires flow engineering.
Finish step drops 35.2% and support explicitly reports post-onboarding control confusion; adding a screen is costly.
Home wait step has 18.7% drop-off and high mean time (2336s); high build cost for custom mini-game flow.
Both funnel and 8 support tickets highlight sign-in confusion; cheap text/hint fix but affects small user segment.
Choose_path loses 23.8% with an unusually long 514s mean time; grid layout simplifies decision hierarchy.
Directly targets initial step drop-off (23.8%) with simple copy tweak.
Addresses long tail home step wait time (2336s mean) by encouraging safe backgrounding via desktop alert.
